decisions.decision: Fix the walker, not the simulator. vendor-sim.py already returns success on the second recordInfo poll (lines 1925-1933). The real gap is that the walkers stop before the content-schedule job runs its next poll. In app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs and walk-ui.mjs, after the last step, poll the attendee's job list until every job is done or failed: every 2s, with a hard limit of 120s (an env override is fine). If the limit runs out, report a finding that names the stuck job and its state. Do not loosen the sim. Then run the rsp, webinar and challenge walkers on the local centre and simulator, followed by the run-chain. Confirm 0 findings, every job done, and no Kie.ai timing line in the summary. Commit to main, push, log it in docs/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md, and move T-242 to review with the walker and run-chain output.
